note.note:
I don’t have the transcript or the DDx JSON. Please provide both so I can generate the SOAP note.

What I need:
- The raw transcript text (conversation between clinician and patient).
- The Differential Diagnosis JSON (DDx) produced by the diagnostic agent.

Optional but helpful:
- Any existing vitals, exam findings, medications with doses, allergies, or investigation results if not in the transcript.

When you provide those, I will produce the structured SOAP clinical note following the exact format and rules you specified.
